verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy axis for an AI email client that syncs mail to its own servers, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no documented retention settings or data-deletion controls. Community comments mention deleting the Shortwave account to switch back to Gmail, but that is framed as an exit path and never says synced data is purged. Another user wishes for a denylist that would keep some mail from ever syncing, which suggests no such control exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
